new_articles.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix'이다. Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them. SK Hynix said graduates must work for the company for a period equal to the duration of their financial support She was able to propose solutions to real industry issues directly to the SK Hynix executives themselves and receive live feedback from them SK Hynix told CNBC that while there are no formal internships or hands-on field experiences offered currently, there are considerations to implement those in the future SK Hynix said it also partially participates in curriculum design and review Jung told CNBC that SK Hynix employees come to the campus for seminars and special lectures. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: Kia’s electric van lineup is getting more interesting with reveal of PV7

Look around, and you'll start to notice an uptick in these breadboxes on wheels. Sales were up 21 percent in 2025, suggesting that the humble minivan is shaking off its "uncool" stigma and finding new fans among an SUV-weary public. I'm […]. If they are attractively priced — and this is Kia, so it’s safe to assume that’s possible — I really think these vans would do numbers They’re built on Kia’s dedicated PBV architecture (E-GMP Kia claims the Cargo Long-Range version will get 460km (285 While Kia’s not saying whether the PV7 will be making its way to the US anytime soon, a version has been spotted testing in the US, according to Electrek I get why Kia would hesitate to name the US as a future market, what with our well-documented history of cutting off our nose to spite our face. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
